sub_dimensions.name: Keyword Usage

scoring_criteria.5: Includes either primary or secondary keyword, but not both
scoring_criteria.10: Includes both primary and secondary keywords naturally

sop_checklist: Includes brand name, item type, and size or model
edge_cases: If product type is too generic (e.g., 'bag'), deduct 1–2 points

sub_dimensions.name: Readability

scoring_criteria.0: Keyword stuffing, poor grammar or unnatural phrasing
scoring_criteria.5: Acceptable structure but lacks flow or polish

sop_checklist: Follows sentence casing or proper title case
edge_cases: If title has typos or confusing fragments, score ≤5
If overly long but readable, score capped at 8

sub_dimensions.name: Length
edge_cases: Score 5 if length is good but readability suffers
Score 0 if title is under 60 chars even with keywords

Keyword Usage: Include both primary and secondary high-volume keywords relevant to the product type.
Avoid duplication of similar terms like 'portable' and 'compact' together if redundant.
If brand or model is missing, add them to meet SOP checklist.
Readability: Avoid keyword stuffing — use natural phrasing even when including important terms.
Break long clauses into clean, comma-separated phrases.
Ensure proper capitalization and avoid ALL CAPS or symbols.
Length: Target 120–150 characters for maximum desktop and mobile visibility.
Remove low-impact modifiers (e.g., 'very effective', 'nice design') if over 150 chars.
Add usage context or benefits if the title is too short (under 60 characters).
